sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We deeply value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract.
While we treat our detailed internal calculations as confidential, our team will provide further context regarding your request.
In recognition of the extended contract term and the April 2027 effective date, we can offer a revised price of €51.80 per unit with 30-day payment terms.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued effort to find common ground and deeply value our long-standing partnership. The collaboration between our companies over the years means a great deal to our foundry and our team.

In response to your latest step, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.60 per unit for the 30-day payment term. Under our Angebot, this unit price comes with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 April 2027. We are reaching the limits of what is possible for our foundry, but we remain committed to reaching a fair agreement.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
